description: Main-window-only grants (trmx-74): core:window:allow-close lets the tab manager close the window when the last tab closes. Scoped to main so the settings window gains no close-by-script surface it does not need. trmx-145 adds clipboard-manager:allow-write-text — WRITE-ONLY (no read grant, matching the OSC 52 write-only stance) and main-only, so terminal copies reach the native pasteboard while the settings window gains no clipboard surface at all. trmx-252 (L13) adds the 14 app commands only the PTY-owning window may invoke: the PTY lifecycle (open/write/ack/resize/close), the control-socket reply, the close-gate trio, the pending-open-paths drain (main.tsx already restrains itself here — the Rust command has no window check, so this is where it becomes enforced), and the four deterministic-launch commands that the smoke and perf harnesses drive.
